name: web-search-gemini
description: External web SEARCH provider: hosts the web-search@1 service object (registry + selection + cap) and registers ONE engine, `gemini`, whose answers come from the Google GEMINI API's native `google_search` grounding tool (server-side web search with real source URLs in groundingMetadata). No third-party search API, no browser, no paid search key: the only request it issues is models/<id>:generateContent with x-goog-api-key resolved BY NAME through ctx.credentials.

config.description: The seam config (provider/fallback/count/maxCount/maxChars/spill/timeoutMs) plus the one engine this row hosts. With no row the service is absent and `web search` answers missing-service, exactly as before.

provider.description: Default engine id (defaults to the only registered engine, `gemini`).

fallback.description: Ordered fallback chain consulted when the default engine cannot run.

apiKeyEnv.description: Credential NAME of the Gemini API key (default GEMINI_API_KEY). A NAME only: the value is resolved at CALL time through ctx.credentials, never read from config, never logged.

model.description: Gemini model id used for the grounded search (default gemini-2.5-flash, a real API-accepted id).

apiBase.description: API root (default https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta); a proxy or a stub server may override it.

engineId.description: Engine id registered with the seam (default gemini), the value a request names with `engine:`.

grounded.description: Send the native google_search grounding tool (default true). false keeps the same route but answers without web grounding.

count.description: Default result count of a call that names none (default 5).

maxCount.description: Hard ceiling of a caller-supplied count (default and max 20, the contract's ceiling).

maxChars.description: Inline character cap of one answer (default 12000).

spill.description: Hand the overflow of the cap to spill@1 (default false: this row answers capped and reports dropped).

timeoutMs.description: Per-call deadline of one Gemini request in ms (default 15000, max 120000).
